text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tap Dance City was reading
the fan letters she had received—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Dear Tap Dance City-sama. Ever since I saw you run at the Freestyle Racetrack, I've been cheering you on!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We don't see you around here as often lately,
which makes me feel a bit lonely, but—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you run in official races and feel so far away,
my feelings of cheering you on will never change!
Please keep doing your best toward your dream!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Quite the distant existence, huh.
...If I recall, there was a regular race scheduled for today.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Alright, let's go meet this girl!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... Tap-san?!
Why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you really were here.
You're the one who wrote that letter, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! To think I'd run into you here!
Haaah, I'm so glad I came!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, you don't ask for much, do you? Just meeting me is enough?

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan
text_block_list.text:
!! I-I want to see it again!
Seeing Tap-san run here...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: All right!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on! Is that the best you've got?!
Come on!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: YEAAAAAAAHOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Foo~~! Worked up a great sweat!
Good race!
choice_data_list: Even with no practice, that was a great run!
Even with no practice, that was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Really! It was incredible!!
So free... so full of joy—

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might've become someone far away once you went into the world of official racing...
but you're still the same Tap-san as back then!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, exactly.
I'm having fun running and continuing to chase my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing's gonna change.
'Cause this is my way of life!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to feel lonely.
Just believe in me and cheer me on. OK?

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees!!
No matter where you go, I'll keep cheering for you!!
